name: Gaea

source.map_area_convention: [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive; original icon-image pixels, x right, y down
source.geometry_convention: Clockwise y-down polygons, not repeated closed vertex; simplified visible roof/main-structure footprints; heights above local ground/platform
source.rotation_convention: Pad rotation_deg: clockwise from +x to first polygon edge, modulo 180; a drawing reference, not a pad class or in-game heading

scale.how: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
scale.basis: User-confirmed classes, user working dimensions Large170x90m, Medium135x70m, Small70x50m.
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

fingerprint.description: One large western landing area faces a radar-dish CMD, compact PWR and two IND/LAB factory complexes linked by utility paths and tank arrays.

height_estimate_basis.matched_module: Low rectangular command body carrying a large tilted radar/communications dish
height_estimate_basis.notes: Reuses Layout4 CMD estimate: roof about6m (rough4-8), one principal occupied storey. Match is module-family exterior, not exact footprint/orientation. Dish and pedestal height are excluded from main-roof height and recorded separately. Access numerals/carets do not establish storeys; no metric photogrammetry.

height_estimate_basis.matched_module: Square/rectangular PWR body with central round power machinery
height_estimate_basis.notes: Reuses Layout4 PWR main roof about8m, one occupied level, even where machinery volume is taller. Layout5 is a smaller standalone variant rather than full Layout4 wings. Main roof excludes central dome/machinery top, separately estimated about13m above local ground.

height_estimate_basis.matched_module: Connected processing/laboratory bays with flat roof decks, raised rectangular plant and paired cylindrical roof equipment
height_estimate_basis.notes: Reuses Layout4 factory guess8m/2floors. Side1 and Side3 show comparable factory wall/raised-bay modules. Exact component arrangement is different; this may be one tall industrial bay with partial upper deck instead of two full floors. Excludes tanks, exhaust plant and rooftop equipment tops.

height_estimate_basis.matched_module: Attached LAB/IND factory bays with raised processing roof and external cylindrical tanks
height_estimate_basis.notes: One connected physical roof; both LAB labels and IND retained in printed_labels. Reuses Layout4 factory guess8m/2floors, supported by tall industrial bays in Side2/3. Could instead be one tall bay plus partial upper level; no floor inferred from blue access markers. External tank tops are separate details.

height_estimate_basis.matched_module: Low pad-side control/service hut with offset flat roof bays
height_estimate_basis.notes: Generic repeated utility-hut family, not exact copy: comparable pad-side service units in Side1 and Side3 appear one low storey. Best guess3.5m to main roof; antenna excluded.

height_estimate_basis.matched_module: Three-bay low utility/service connector building beside walkway
height_estimate_basis.notes: Comparable low flat-roof service/hangar modules visible in Side1/3, exact layout not matched. Best guess4m one storey; longer footprint does not imply extra height.
Generic exterior-family fallback: single low utility cube comparable to isolated service boxes in Layout1/4 side views. No exact module identity or measured scale; best guess4m one storey.

height_estimate_basis.matched_module: Low rectangular flat-topped utility structure with shallow service bays
height_estimate_basis.notes: Generic fallback from low service structures in Side1/3; enclosed volume versus open equipment enclosure is uncertain.4m/1floor is a best-guess visual model, not confirmed occupation.

height_estimate_basis.matched_module: Detached compact industrial utility/plant annex with roof vents
height_estimate_basis.notes: Best guess6m one tall storey from lower factory annexes in Layout4 (rough5-6m) and compact plant bays in Side2. No exact corresponding module is confirmed. Roof plant/exhaust top is not included in main roof estimate.

uncertain: Historical tracing note, superseded by this revision's scale and verified pad classes: No Industrial5 Side image exists. All numeric roof heights/floors are explicitly LOW-confidence best guesses transferred from Industrial4 matching modules or Industrial1-3 exterior-family analogues; per-building height_estimate_basis names the reference and fallback level. No metric scale/photogrammetry is claimed.

CMD main roof6m/one floor and radar highest point26m above ground/20m above roof reuse Industrial4 CMD analogue. The dish total is not the main-roof height. PWR similarly separates8m body roof from13m power-machinery top.

Both factory complexes use8m/two floors from Industrial4 factory-family guess, but may be a single tall processing bay with only partial upper deck. Smaller service huts use generic3.5-6m/one-storey fallbacks; these are less secure than CMD/PWR matches.

Connected eastern roof carries IND and two LAB labels; printed_labels retains all three without inventing room divisions. Western IND is a separate physical complex. No HAB labels are visible, so fingerprint.habs is0.

All point.floor values are null: door numerals and L0/>L0 are security/access levels, not storeys. Carets in2^,3^ and terminal screen glyphs are transcribed literally without conversion to physical floors.

Footprints trace visible main roof/structure envelopes, with right-angle module corners and simplified steps. Rounded tanks and roof fixtures use simple curved-envelope approximations; eaves, projection and marker occlusion prevent exact ground-wall recovery.

Historical tracing note, superseded by this revision's scale and verified pad classes: Landing-pad outline follows the visible painted corner positions rather than a ship silhouette or inferred pad class. Perspective makes the observed quadrilateral slightly non-rectangular; scale remains null and the parked craft, touchdown-circle artwork and shadow are excluded.
Tank footprint envelopes include visible vessel/base projection but exclude long dark ground shadows; cylindrical tank heights are generic family fallbacks, not measured from shadow lengths.
Paved and raised utility links stop at visible endpoints. Gaps between buildings, paving and door icons are intentional; no route is extended through unseen or unpaved ground.

The blue i is editorial information assigned to nearby CMD with low confidence and no physical device implied. Orange website i, CREDIT badge, menus/legend, ships, vehicles, skimmers, people, rocks, steam plumes and cast shadows are excluded.

Small roof plant and cargo functions are conservative low-confidence classifications. All details entries contain only id/kind/outline; detail_notes, detail_confidence and optional height estimates remain keyed top-level metadata.

metric_estimates.scope: One shared pad-based horizontal transform applied to source traces and documented pad reconstructions.

construction.verification: Every live Approximate Shopping List was opened and its commodity IDs/quantities captured. Sorted commodity-pair FNV-1a digest and quantity sum were independently checked against this saved record. Values are approximate, not a guaranteed project bill.

distinctive_geometry_features: One large pad and no HAB roof.
Separate radar-dish CMD and circular-cap PWR between the pad and two large IND/LAB factory masses.
Two factory roofs have repeated roof tanks/chimneys and connected lanes; compact service plant extends away from their lower corner.

pad_correspondence.size_class_basis: Current live Raven classification, confirmed by parent; local/Raven image geometry checked.
pad_correspondence.centre_override_scope: Calibration only; source centre and outline are preserved.
pad_correspondence.recorded_centre_suitable_as_target_ancho: requires exact painted-target check during calibration
pad_correspondence.centre_notes: Recorded centre is preserved. The landing target, ship and apron centroid need not coincide; use a separately verified painted-target anchor for metric fitting.

metric_template.geometry_match: high; correct fixed-building pattern and pad arrangement, independent of name field.

calibration.method: One shared X/Y scale for the whole source image, fitted by least squares in metres to the listed independent visible pad-side controls; uniform fallback when directional scales are not identifiable or would require excessive stretch.
calibration.basis: Human-confirmed pad classes and agreed working dimensions
limitations: A confirmed class does not identify a precise mechanical deck boundary: traced paint/apron envelopes are approximate.
One shared transform retains residuals at individual pads. Reference dimensions are not forced independently on each pad.
Reconstructed hidden edges are inferred, not additional calibration observations. Negative/out-of-image pixels are permitted only for documented reconstructions.
Camera perspective, roof parallax and terrain can cause local differences; estimates are unsuitable for survey accuracy.
No statistical confidence interval is claimed. Roof heights and floor estimates are preserved.

Colonisation.metric_height_policy: Prior roof/storey/equipment height estimates are retained, with their original confidence/basis. The revised pad-based registration updates horizontal metres and visible footprint dimensions.

previous_scale.how: Pad target and matched template feature registration in independently established metre coordinates.
previous_scale.basis: Visually matched SrvSurvey telemetry-based metric layout: verified pad classes/positions with roof or physical-feature checks. Physical S/M/L pad deck dimensions are not treated as officially specified.
previous_scale.limitations: Approximate uniform horizontal scale; camera perspective, terrain, roof parallax and cropped/obscured landing targets limit accuracy. Range is a practical judgement, not a statistical confidence interval.

previous_calibration.range_note: Deliberate practical uncertainty envelope for template/control placement and perspective; not a confidence interval and not derived from assumed pad dimensions.

geometry_m.coordinate_precision_note: Four decimals support reproducible drawing and do not imply millimetre physical accuracy.
geometry_m.height_policy: Original height_m and floor estimates are retained; horizontal calibration does not establish heights.

geometry_m.superseded_note: Kept for traceability. site_m holds the plan fitted to SrvSurvey's measured positions, in SrvSurvey's site frame.

frame.origin: Settlement position from the journal (ApproachSettlement Latitude/Longitude), as SrvSurvey uses it
frame.heading: Site heading = ship heading while docked on pad 1, or ship heading minus that pad's rotation_deg on any other pad (SrvSurvey HumanSiteData).
frame.to_world: bearing = heading + atan2(x, y); east = x*cos(h) + y*sin(h); north = -x*sin(h) + y*cos(h)
frame.rotation_convention: rotation_deg and rot_deg are clockwise from +y
frame.floor_convention: SrvSurvey floors: 1 = ground floor, 2 = one floor up, 3 = two floors up. SrvSurvey also uses 0: on every combat-zone point and on a few others, where its meaning isn't documented; those are copied as given. floor_basis says where each floor came from: srvsurvey, or icon carets (the plan's ^ marks, no caret = ground floor). plan_floor keeps the plan's reading where SrvSurvey's differs.
frame.access_convention: Security level 0-3: SrvSurvey's level where matched, otherwise the plan's printed number
frame.source_convention: plan = only on the plan; srvsurvey = only in SrvSurvey; plan+srvsurvey = both, at SrvSurvey's position

site_m.pixel_to_site_note: [X, Y, W] = M . [px, py, 1]; site = (X/W, Y/W). Third row is [0, 0, 1] for a uniform fit.
